source.dev_result: Unpromising: 3/9 nominal gates, ~57x tournament acquisition time. Development-only; not frozen evidence.

question: Can explicit expected causal-hypothesis information gain with a precommitted single-hypothesis model-mismatch fallback to conventional D-optimal acquisition outperform predictive-disagreement tournament, D-optimal, and random controls reliably across both known-bank and out-of-bank causal mechanisms?
hypothesis: A robust expected-KL selector conditioned ONLY on observed consequences selects interventions that improve unseen cold-consequence MSE at least 5% over every alternative OMP acquisition policy and 5% over any conventional policy/learner pair, with strictly positive per-seed margins and bounded total acquisition compute.

generator.kind: synthetic randomized do-intervention; no protected dataset or Yggdrasil weights
generator.latent: 4 old shared lower-order signed mechanisms, one new-only 4 or 5-way causal factor; hidden factor identity withheld. Source family banks known only to 24-term candidate grammar; novel parity5/conditional5 not representable by any single bank feature. All model families have 2 nuisance cues with old/new/cold shifts.
generator.source_note: Finite authored bank, source-free synthetic worlds; not arbitrary operator discovery or native tokenless cognition.

methods.candidate_policy: After 4 common NEW anchors, each step computes posterior weights of 24 one-factor residual hypotheses fitted on already observed NEW outcomes. Candidate action maximizes 5-point Gauss-Hermite approximation to mutual information I(hypothesis; outcome). If min per-hypothesis SSE divided by observed residual energy exceeds 0.55, fallback to conventional regularized D-optimal for that step. Hypothetical outcome likelihood Gaussian sigma .45, integrator 5 nodes; deterministic tie break. Model fit uses only seen labels, never held labels.
methods.strong_controls: Unconditional expected-KL EIG ablation, existing ENERGY-53 predictive-variance tournament, conventional D-optimal, Hamming diversity, random. Same information, action budget, shared old OMP4 checkpoint and 24 candidate factors. All 3 downstream refits from actual selected labels.
methods.budget: One prospective 24-world screen on exact seeds 99851 and 99863, one identical-source semantic replay, source-sharing reimplementation of selection and all 18 model refits. No hyperparameter tuning after scoring. 36-world reserved primary only if screen passes.
methods.environment: Linux CPU Python 3.13.5 NumPy 2.3.5 SciPy 1.17.0 scikit-learn 1.8.0, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, no GPU/paid API.
methods.timing: Acquisition wall seconds measured separately per policy, model-fit seconds separately, not physical power/Joules or complete process cost.
methods.independence: Auditor reimplements EIG posterior integration and all selectors/learner constructors; shares synthetic generator, NumPy/sklearn and source bank so not fully independent science.

frozen_screen_gates.gain5_vs_best_omp: robust_eig+OMP aggregate cold MSE <=0.95 × best pooled cold MSE among 5 other acquisition policies+OMP
frozen_screen_gates.gain5_vs_best_any: robust_eig+OMP aggregate cold MSE <=0.95 × best pooled cold MSE among 5 other policies ×3 fully trained downstream learners
frozen_screen_gates.gain10_vs_random_omp: robust_eig+OMP cold MSE <=0.90 × random+OMP cold MSE
frozen_screen_gates.gain3_vs_tournament_omp: robust_eig+OMP cold MSE <=0.97 × original tournament+OMP cold MSE
frozen_screen_gates.per_seed_strict_both: robust_eig+OMP strictly better cold MSE than best other+OMP separately in BOTH 99851 and 99863 (critical)
frozen_screen_gates.every_family_at_most10pct_worse: robust_eig+OMP pooled cold MSE no more than 1.10 × best other OMP acquisition separately for EACH bank_parity4,novel_parity5,novel_conditional5
frozen_screen_gates.old_predictions_exact: robust_eig held OLD MSE exactly equals frozen old OMP4 checkpoint in each case
frozen_screen_gates.fallback_exercised: fallback_count >0 and <12×number_of_worlds across screen, not all D-opt and not never
frozen_screen_gates.selection_compute_below8x_tournament: robust_eig sum selection seconds <=8× conventional predictor-variance tournament selection seconds on same local CPU (not total process cost)

screen_decision.SCREEN_PROMISING: Requires all three critical gates gain5_vs_best_omp, gain5_vs_best_any, per_seed_strict_both PASS AND ≥8/9 gates PASS AND independent full audit PASS; only then eligible for separately authorized reserved primary.
screen_decision.SCREEN_NO_GO: Any of 3 critical gates fail or fewer than 8 gates pass, with valid source and auditor PASS. Stop, no primary, no postscore tuning.
screen_decision.INVALID: Any prereg run order violation, source SHA drift, hidden/held leakage, wrong split, unequal labels, missing controls, audit score discrepancy or silent code changes. Infrastructure CI separately classified.

reproducible.preprimary: Source, three included Python originals and auditor committed at 66aec145d0ea97d2ed2d54ff1d48da14639f035f before prereg; only excluded development seed 99839 scored so far.

prohibitions: No additional score or thresholds on consumed seeds, no promotion to native Yggdrasil without independent qualification, no accepted ref/main/loop/controller/runner/queue/scheduler mutation, no merge/deployment, no paid APIs.
